task: Pick the value for the blank that makes the code print <class 'str'>.

options.why: 12 has no decimal point and no quotes, so it is a whole number (int). A minus sign does not change that.
12.0 has a decimal point, so it is a decimal (float), not a whole number.
-12 has no decimal point and no quotes, so it is a whole number (int). A minus sign does not change that.

ok: Only "12" has quotes, so it is text (str).
